title: Astrid and the Cipher
author: Mara Delacroix
blurb: Ada Nystrom, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent three years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when a body turns up dressed in clothes stolen from the witness's own closet, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, he must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the tide gives up what it took.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
